title: Make-A-Story carry-over story bible: Python data model and prompt builder
purpose: Reusable Python module operationalising the per-scene carry-over table from art_01M6HGFBNCDERMNM02HZPN7SYE rev 1 (Make-A-Story, arXiv 2211.13319v3, CC0 1.0). StoryBible and SceneEntry dataclasses, carry_over_prompt() that injects resolved references and appearance phrases, baseline_prompt() that does not, and validate() that flags unresolved pronouns. Intended for artists using any image model who need explicit carry-over tracking—doing in a story bible what Story-LDM does inside its visual memory.
